skill_name: Fruit of the Tree of Might
mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Power Up Super from Turles's Instructor Quest 3. Eating the fruit powers up normal attacks for 30 seconds; an additional input during the eating animation teleports the user in front of the opponent and performs a stunning strike. Exact attack-power multiplier, activation frames, and stacking interactions remain unresolved.
